introHtml: Lmrk cooling sport towels are engineered for active use, combining advanced moisture-wicking fabric with durable construction that holds up to repeated wetting and wringing. Whether you need branded towels for a corporate golf tournament, a summer safety kit, or a team giveaway, Lmrk offers reliable performance and a smooth surface for screen printing or embroidery. These towels stay cool longer than standard cotton options, making them a practical choice for outdoor events and industrial heat stress programs.
